subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should repeated exec calls with identical arguments and the same nonzero exit identity be treated as no progress even when their stdout or stderr changes?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but this choice deliberately trades stronger runaway-loop protection for the possibility of blocking legitimate nonzero polling or retry workflows; repository evidence cannot determine the desired availability policy.

options.title: Accept stable nonzero identity
options.body: Approve the branch after rebasing, accepting that changing output does not count as progress while the same command continues returning the same nonzero exit identity.

options.title: Preserve semantic output progress
options.body: Pause the PR and define a narrower normalization or explicit progress signal for nonzero commands before changing the blocker policy.

recommendation.title: Accept stable nonzero identity
recommendation.body: Approve the branch after rebasing, accepting that changing output does not count as progress while the same command continues returning the same nonzero exit identity.
